title: Inverse Proportion
summary: More workers, fewer days; faster speed, less time. When the product stays the same.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 3: Proportional Reasoning-2
Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Direct and Inverse Proportions

objectives: I can solve inverse proportion problems using a constant product.
I can compare direct and inverse proportion.
misconceptions: If one quantity goes down when the other goes up, it's always inverse proportion.
Inverse proportion graphs are straight lines.
